_comment: Single source of truth for the PL control-register map over PS GP0.
Edit THIS file, then run `make -C tools regmap` (or tools/gen_regmap.py).
CI runs `gen_regmap.py --check` and fails on drift.
notes: The slave claims 0x000..0xFFF (addr[15:12]==0); sally_rom_loader OR-muxes at 0x1000+.
Every register is 32-bit word-aligned (Xil_In32/Out32, no byte-lane tricks); reads never alias writes.
Runs on clk_sys (same domain as the blitter) — no CDC on the register bus.

blocks.name: BLITTER
blocks.desc: blit regs (offset = bl_addr) + STATUS/SEQ reads; dual-access 6502 $D4Bx/$D4Cx/$D4Ex under UNLK_BLIT

ranges.desc: blitter registers DST/PAT/CMD/SRC/FLAGS (bl_addr = offset); see blitter.h XT_BL_*
SRC/DST DDR-surface descriptors / ROW0 bases (bl_addr = offset)

blocks.name: SPRITE
blocks.desc: sprite-engine reg index/data port; dual-access 6502 $D4Ax/$D4Dx under UNLK_SPRITE

regs.desc: sprite reg data + strobe (writes idx/data to engine)
collision[col_sel] (set col_sel first via $D4D9); [15:0] = sprites this one hit

blocks.name: CTRL
blocks.desc: control plane (gp0_ctrl, SALLY speed, XT unlock, keyboard inject)

regs.desc: SALLY clock_mult (dual: 6502 $D4CA); read = effective. W -> bl_addr $D4CA

compositor plane arrangement (A9-only; reset 0x210 = current). depth: [3:0]=desktop, [7:4]=overlay, [11:8]=XL. alpha_en: [16]=desktop, [17]=overlay, [18]=XL. Route-A flip = desktop on top with alpha (0x00010132)

[0]=1 HOLD the SALLY realm in reset (A9-only; reset 0 = running). Cold-boot-per-launch: hold, rewrite the OS/RAM through the ROM-loader window (0x1000+), release = fresh coldstart. Resets the 6502 core AND the XT state a stock guest cannot know about (bank selects $D5C0/$D5C1, screen banking $D5C3-5); the video pipeline keeps scanning
TEMP ROM-window upload diag: [31:16]=window AXI writes accepted, [15:0]=rom_we pulses emitted to sally_mem
TEMP ROM-window upload diag: [23:8]=last rom_addr, [7:0]=last rom_data

blocks.name: XLCTL
blocks.desc: XL compositor-plane window placement (A9-positioned emulation window)

regs.desc: [0]=1: use these regs (A9-positioned); 0: legacy gp0_ctrl-scale centred

blocks.name: MATH
blocks.desc: math-coprocessor mailbox (A9-only); 6502 side = $D5C6-$D5C8 + the $4000-$5FFF math page

regs.desc: doorbell event pop: [8]=valid, [7:0]=chunk index; a read consumes one event; IRQ_F2P[1] level = FIFO non-empty
completion: [7:0]=chunk, [15:8]=result-span first line (64 B lines), [23:16]=line count; reloads the span into the math page if that chunk is resident, then raises $D5C7 done
[0]=engine busy, [1]=chunk resident/ready, [2]=evt FIFO non-empty, [15:8]=resident chunk, [23:16]=evt FIFO fill

blocks.name: TRNG
blocks.desc: hardware entropy (ring-oscillator TRNG in the PL; A9-only, read-only)

regs.desc: whitened 32-bit entropy word (free-running pool snapshot); read repeatedly for fresh words. Entropy SOURCE for the OS pool, not raw crypto output

blocks.name: DEBUG
blocks.desc: in-fabric 6502 debugger (xt6502_debug): halt/step/breakpoint/register access, driving /bin/6502. Halt is a non-destructive rdy-gate (state preserved); all actions align to the ST_FETCH instruction boundary. Status is coherent when halted (a halted core is static). Sel 0x9 is RESERVED for the future ANTIC debugger. See docs/OS/6502-debug.md

regs.desc: write (any) -> run to the next instruction boundary, then freeze (state preserved). Also arms halt-at-reset when combined with a SALLYRST pulse
write (any) -> release the core, run at the configured speed
write N -> execute exactly N instructions (min 1) then freeze
[0]=bkpt_en (arm the PC breakpoint), [1]=halt_at_reset (freeze at the reset-vector fetch after the next SALLYRST release)
[15:0]=breakpoint PC; when bkpt_en, the core freezes at the ST_FETCH of this address (before executing it)
write (any) -> inject DBG_WPC/WAXYS/WPSH into the core's PC/regs and re-anchor at ST_FETCH (only meaningful while halted)
inject on DBG_COMMIT: [7:0]=P (NV-BDIZC) [11:8]=SP high nibble (12-bit xt stack)
[15:0]=PC snapshot at the last instruction boundary (coherent when halted = next instruction to execute)
retired-instruction count since SALLYRST (increments on each ST_FETCH boundary)
RESERVED (reads 0 for now): display beam position at the last boundary — [15:0]=scanline [31:16]=beam-x — for future ANTIC/DLI correlation
instruction-trace ring: [0]=enable (capture {PC,A,X,Y,SP,P} every ST_DECODE boundary), [1]=break_on_full (halt the core when the ring wraps). Ring is 4096 deep; readable only when halted (static).
trace write pointer: [11:0]=next write slot (newest = WPTR-1), [16]=wrapped (ring has been full at least once), [17]=broke_on_full
set the ring read index (0..4095); the entry appears in DBG_TRC_PC/AXYS/P
[15:0]=PC of the traced instruction at DBG_TRC_IDX
